description.en: Disables the in-match pause/return menu identified by the given menu ID string, preventing the player from opening it during a scripted sequence.
Always null — the native implementation never pushes a value onto the stack on success; null is also returned if no menuId argument was given.

example.code:
// Disable the pause menu during a scripted match sequence
CMND_BTL_DISABLE_RETURN_MENU("KsnBtlMenu");
